defect.reproducer: In pr06-defect commit d626a8a249aca954fec76e62d133259610133358, lidar_joint parent=camera_link with unchanged offset. check_urdf accepts it, but test_sensor_parent_and_offset[lidar_link] fails and tf2_echo reports (0.56, 0, 0.76).
defect.root_cause: The camera offset (0.28, 0, 0.38) is added to the lidar offset (0.28, 0, 0.38) because lidar_link is attached to camera_link instead of base_link.
defect.proof_after: On pr06, the same parent test passes, check_urdf accepts the model, view_frames reports base_link as lidar_link parent, and tf2_echo reports (0.28, 0, 0.38).
